title: Review of lab 1's ad4-protocell (IB) on fresh seeds 7 and 8: replicated; 10-12 droplets of bounded size persist with a self-made amphiphile rim (rim/core 3.9-4.0, 61/63-64 individuals), and the population freezes by t~5000
summary: Re-ran threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad4-protocell/world.py unchanged (128^2, t=20000) on seeds 7 and 8. Six planted droplets of alternating catalyst kind grow on the fuel; the faster kind's droplets elongate and divide (5 persistent splits, generation 2 on each seed, 0 merges), and by t~5000 the population is a static array of 11-12 droplets that persist to the end (10-11 tracks alive for >= half the run, persistent-track area ratio 1.9-2.6). The amphiphile psi forms a rim on every droplet: rim/core 3.96 / 3.91, rim/out 19.0 / 19.1, 61/64 and 61/63 individuals membrane-like. psi is made by the droplets' catalysed reaction (u c^2 (ka a + kb b), negligible in the bath) and drifts up grad|grad phi|^2, so the layer is self-made (RUBRIC L3 quasi-equilibrium clause).

observations.I: rerun8/sheet.png: 11 discrete droplets of bounded size persisting from t~5000 to 20000 (3 tracks alive start to end)
observations.B: rerun8/radial.png: psi rim/core 3.91, rim/out 19.1, 61/63 membrane-like; seed 7 3.96 / 19.0, 61/64

verdicts.limitation: Planted founders. The shell has no back-reaction and is placed by a drift up |grad phi|^2, so it is a passive quasi-equilibrium layer, 1-2 px wide, with no resolution test. The population freezes early (as lab 1 noted), so this is a static array of shelled droplets.
